definitions.gloss: expertise; specialized nature (of work or knowledge)
definitions.explanation: The quality of requiring, or having, specialized knowledge and skill. Used of jobs, fields, and qualifications, and of the people who have such skill.

examples.japanese: {専門性|せんもんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
{専門性|せんもんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{専門性|せんもんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{未経験|みけいけん}→未経験：17726_mikeiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦やや→やや：03642_yaya⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: This job requires specialized expertise, so it is rather difficult for someone without experience.

notes:
⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧ (specialty) + 〜⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ (-ness). Common in job ads, career talk, and discussions of the professions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {専門性|せんもんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: highly specialized
- {専門性|せんもんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧ / {身|み}につける: to raise / acquire expertise
- {専門性|せんもんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧: to make use of one's expertise
- ⟦{高度|こうど}→高度：00243_koudo⟧な{専門性|せんもんせい}: advanced expertise
